## Introduction

This is my first Python analysis post!

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {"Month": ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr"], 
        "Value": [120, 145, 133, 160]}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.bar(df["Month"], df["Value"], color="#2563eb")
ax.set_title("My First Chart")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Conclusion

This is how easy it is to embed Python analysis in a blog post!
